about:
Passport Wholesale Furnishings & Interior Design operates showrooms in Henderson, Nevada, and Utah, serving the public without membership requirements. The company presents itself as a furniture and design store where customers can walk through collections spanning furnishings, accessories, carpets, and bedding. No founding year, ownership structure, or founder names are disclosed in the available information.

The business functions as a retail destination rather than a manufacturer. Its showrooms display finished goods for immediate purchase, and the company offers interior design assistance to help customers reimagine bedrooms and revitalize living spaces. Facility size, headcount, inventory volume, and part-number counts are not provided.

The customer base consists of residential buyers and design-conscious consumers visiting the physical locations in Nevada and Utah. No industrial, commercial, or contract clients are mentioned, and no specific industry verticals beyond home furnishings are identified.

The company does not state a founding mission or a declared differentiator in the source material. Its public-facing description emphasizes accessibility — no memberships needed — and the breadth of on-display collections.
